Apple___Apple_scab.base_recommendation: Apply organic sulfur or copper-based fungicide before rain; rake and destroy fallen scabby leaves; prune canopy to improve airflow.

Apple___Black_rot.base_recommendation: Prune out dead wood and mummified fruit; apply captan or copper spray from green-tip through fruit set; sanitize pruning shears.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.base_recommendation: Remove nearby juniper/cedar galls if feasible; spray myclobutanil or sulfur at pink-bud and petal-fall stages.

Apple___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Maintain balanced NPK fertilization, drip irrigation, and routine dormant-season pruning.

Blueberry___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Maintain acidic soil pH (4.5-5.5), pine-bark mulch, and consistent moisture.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.base_recommendation: Apply potassium bicarbonate, neem oil, or wettable sulfur at first white powdery signs; thin dense shoots to reduce humidity.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Continue preventive orchard sanitation and balanced irrigation.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.base_recommendation: Rotate away from corn for 1-2 seasons; manage crop residue; apply strobilurin or triazole fungicide if lesions reach ear leaf before tasseling.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.base_recommendation: Monitor pustules on lower leaves; apply foliar fungicide (azoxystrobin/propiconazole) if rust spreads rapidly prior to silking.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.base_recommendation: Use resistant hybrids; rotate crops; apply foliar fungicide at tasseling if cigar-shaped lesions cover >5% of upper leaves.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Ensure adequate nitrogen side-dressing during V6-V8 vegetative growth.

Grape___Black_rot.base_recommendation: Remove mummified berries and infected tendrils during winter pruning; apply mancozeb, myclobutanil, or copper from budbreak to 4 weeks post-bloom.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).base_recommendation: Prune during dry weather and seal large pruning wounds with trichoderma or wound paste; remove severely declined cordons.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.base_recommendation: Improve canopy ventilation via leaf pulling; apply copper oxychloride or Bordeaux mixture after rainfall.

Grape___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Maintain canopy training and monitor humidity during berry development.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).base_recommendation: Control Asian citrus psyllid vectors immediately using horticultural mineral oil or approved insecticides; remove confirmed HLB-infected trees to protect the grove and use certified disease-free nursery stock.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.base_recommendation: Apply fixed copper sprays at leaf drop and pre-bloom; avoid overhead irrigation and excessive nitrogen that produces tender susceptible shoots.

Peach___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Maintain open-center pruning and balanced soil moisture.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.base_recommendation: Spray fixed copper + mancozeb or biological Bacillus subtilis; avoid working in wet fields; rotate with non-solanaceous crops for 2-3 years.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Maintain calcium nutrition to prevent blossom-end rot and use drip irrigation.

Potato___Early_blight.base_recommendation: Remove heavily blighted lower leaves; apply copper fungicide, chlorothalonil, or azoxystrobin; maintain adequate potassium and nitrogen levels.

Potato___Late_blight.base_recommendation: URGENT: Destroy infected haulms immediately to prevent tuber rot; spray cymoxanil, mandipropamid, or copper oxychloride; hill soil around tubers.

Potato___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Continue hilling and preventive monitoring during cool, humid weather.

Raspberry___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Prune out spent floricanes after harvest to maintain cane airflow.

Soybean___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Monitor nodulation and scout for defoliating insects during pod fill.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.base_recommendation: Spray potassium bicarbonate, neem oil, or sulfur on both upper and lower leaf surfaces; water at the root zone only.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.base_recommendation: Remove and burn old infected leaves after harvest renovation; improve bed drainage and apply copper or captan if lesions expand.

Strawberry___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Keep straw mulch clean and use drip irrigation to protect fruit.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.base_recommendation: Apply copper hydroxide + mancozeb or biological bacteriophages; prune lower leaves to stop soil splash; never handle wet plants.

Tomato___Early_blight.base_recommendation: Prune bottom leaves showing bullseye target rings; mulch soil with straw; spray copper fungicide, Bacillus amyloliquefaciens, or chlorothalonil.

Tomato___Late_blight.base_recommendation: URGENT: Bag and remove severely blighted plants immediately; spray healthy neighbors with copper oxychloride or mandipropamid; avoid overhead watering.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.base_recommendation: Ventilate greenhouse/tunnel to keep relative humidity <85%; prune lower foliage; apply potassium bicarbonate, copper, or chlorothalonil.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.base_recommendation: Remove infected basal leaves; stake plants for airflow; apply copper or mancozeb spray every 7-10 days during wet weather.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.base_recommendation: Spray undersides of leaves with neem oil, insecticidal soap, or abamectin; release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis) and reduce dust/drought stress.

Tomato___Target_Spot.base_recommendation: Improve canopy aeration; avoid wetting foliage; apply azoxystrobin, difenoconazole, or copper fungicide.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.base_recommendation: Uproot and destroy stunted yellow-curled plants; control whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) vectors with yellow sticky traps, fine insect netting, and neem/imidacloprid.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.base_recommendation: Curative - remove and destroy infected plants; disinfect tools and hands with 10% bleach or non-fat milk solution; use certified virus-free seed or transplants.

Tomato___healthy.base_recommendation: Leaf is healthy. Maintain staking, sucker pruning, and consistent drip irrigation with calcium support.
